arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Martinez argued a Section 2680 dismissal triggers the judgment bar.
He stated the bar applies to any FTCA judgment.
Justice Alito questioned the definition of a technical judgment.
Mr. Ramirez argued the Postal Reorganization Act applies the FTCA.
